description: This file defines the IMediaPipelineClient interface, an abstract class that provides callback methods for media playback notifications such as duration, position, native size, network state, playback state, media data availability, QoS updates, and buffer underflow events. It is part of the Rialto media player API and includes constants for special duration values.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineClient
classes.description: An abstract base class for media pipeline clients, providing callback methods for media playback events and status updates.

methods.name: notifyDuration
methods.description: Notify the total duration of the media in nanoseconds; uses special constants for unknown or live streams.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Notify the current playback position in nanoseconds.

methods.name: notifyNativeSize
methods.description: Notify the native video size and pixel aspect ratio.

methods.name: notifyVideoData
methods.description: Notify whether video data is available.

methods.name: notifyAudioData
methods.description: Notify whether audio data is available.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notify that media data is needed, including source ID, frame count, request ID, and shared memory info.

methods.name: notifyCancelNeedMediaData
methods.description: Cancel any outstanding media data request for a given source ID.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Notify a QoS update from the player, including source ID and QoS info.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Notify that a buffer underflow has occurred for a given source ID.
